name: wonderfuljodi-platform
description: Wonderful Jodi Matrimonial Platform (Fullstack Next.js & Express)

scripts.preinstall: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.postbuild:frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join('frontend','.next','static');const dst=p.join('frontend','.next','standalone','frontend','.next','static');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied .next/static to standalone')}" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const src=p.join('frontend','public');const dst=p.join('frontend','.next','standalone','frontend','public');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Copied public/ to standalone')}"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "backend,frontend" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start:all: npx -y concurrently "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
